description: OpenCode running through a generic wrapper with a Claude model must still be tool=opencode. OpenCode chrome identifies the host; Claude Opus and Amazon Bedrock are backend metadata, not evidence of Claude Code. Faithful synthetic reduction of a live OpenCode 1.18.32 pane, with current_command=node to ensure the prompt—not the deterministic process override—makes the distinction.
